target.objective: area mean ambient minus air temperature > 6 C

assumptions: Prescribed uniform exit; cold source flow independent of diameter
Constant density, dry air, passive temperature deficit
Axisymmetric still-air jet; wind and buoyancy excluded
No diffuser/source backpressure, wall warming, moisture or skin model

numerical_phases.gradient: Gauss linear on orthogonal structured mesh
numerical_phases.reason: Remove gradient-limiter switching on a smooth orthogonal mesh; preserve second-order convection. Objective already stable; local residual convergence still required.
